name: Perspective Open-Source Streaming Analytics
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source interactive data grid, pivot-table and chart component for large and streaming datasets; browser WebAssembly and locally run Python/Node.js/Rust integrations without software license fees or vendor-imposed local query quotas.
watch_out: Perspective is an embeddable analytics component, not a free hosted dashboard or database. User supplies hosting, data sources, compute and storage; production security, browser memory and third-party infrastructure costs remain their responsibility.
